# Skip

Drops a number of elements from the start of an array.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
Skip(items, count)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to read, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. |
| `count` | number | How many elements to drop. A whole number of 0 or more; a negative or fractional number, or null, is a runtime error. A count at or past the length of items gives the empty array. |

## Returns

Array. A new array holding the elements of items after the first count, in order. Never null.

## Example

`Skip([1, 2, 3, 4], 2)` returns `[3, 4]`.
